options.name: disable
options.help: Do not log to local disk.

ips-archive.name: ips-archive
ips-archive.help: Enable/disable IPS packet archiving to the local disk.

max-log-file-size.name: max-log-file-size
max-log-file-size.help: Maximum log file size before rolling (1 - 100 Mbytes).

max-policy-packet-capture-size.name: max-policy-packet-capture-size
max-policy-packet-capture-size.help: Maximum size of policy sniffer in MB (0 means unlimited).

roll-schedule.name: roll-schedule
roll-schedule.help: Frequency to check log file for rolling.

options.name: daily
options.help: Check the log file once a day.

options.name: weekly
options.help: Check the log file once a week.

roll-day.name: roll-day
roll-day.help: Day of week on which to roll log file.

roll-time.name: roll-time
roll-time.help: Time of day to roll the log file (hh:mm).

diskfull.name: diskfull
diskfull.help: Action to take when disk is full. The system can overwrite the oldest log messages or stop logging when the disk is full (default = overwrite).

options.name: overwrite
options.help: Overwrite the oldest logs when the log disk is full.

options.name: nolog
options.help: Stop logging when the log disk is full.

upload.name: upload
upload.help: Enable/disable uploading log files when they are rolled.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable uploading log files when they are rolled.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable uploading log files when they are rolled.

upload-destination.name: upload-destination
upload-destination.help: The type of server to upload log files to. Only FTP is currently supported.

options.name: ftp-server
options.help: Upload rolled log files to an FTP server.

uploadip.name: uploadip
uploadip.help: IP address of the FTP server to upload log files to.

uploadport.name: uploadport
uploadport.help: TCP port to use for communicating with the FTP server (default = 21).

source-ip.name: source-ip
source-ip.help: Source IP address to use for uploading disk log files.

uploaduser.name: uploaduser
uploaduser.help: Username required to log into the FTP server to upload disk log files.

uploadpass.name: uploadpass
uploadpass.help: Password required to log into the FTP server to upload disk log files.

uploaddir.name: uploaddir
uploaddir.help: The remote directory on the FTP server to upload log files to.

uploadtype.name: uploadtype
uploadtype.help: Types of log files to upload. Separate multiple entries with a space.
uploadtype.default: traffic event virus webfilter IPS emailfilter dlp-archive anomaly voip dlp app-ctrl waf dns ssh ssl

uploadsched.name: uploadsched
uploadsched.help: Set the schedule for uploading log files to the FTP server (default = disable = upload when rolling).

uploadtime.name: uploadtime
uploadtime.help: Time of day at which log files are uploaded if uploadsched is enabled (hh:mm or hh).

upload-delete-files.name: upload-delete-files
upload-delete-files.help: Delete log files after uploading (default = enable).

options.name: disable
options.help: Do not delete log files after uploading.

upload-ssl-conn.name: upload-ssl-conn
upload-ssl-conn.help: Enable/disable encrypted FTPS communication to upload log files.

options.name: default
options.help: FTPS with high and medium encryption algorithms.

full-first-warning-threshold.name: full-first-warning-threshold
full-first-warning-threshold.help: Log full first warning threshold as a percent (1 - 98, default = 75).

full-second-warning-threshold.name: full-second-warning-threshold
full-second-warning-threshold.help: Log full second warning threshold as a percent (2 - 99, default = 90).

full-final-warning-threshold.name: full-final-warning-threshold
full-final-warning-threshold.help: Log full final warning threshold as a percent (3 - 100, default = 95).

interface-select-method.name: interface-select-method
interface-select-method.help: Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server.

options.name: sdwan
options.help: Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules.

interface.name: interface
interface.help: Specify outgoing interface to reach server.
